entries: A CAAHEP accredited paramedic program is a common certification route, with applicable alternatives checked through NREMT . A state paramedic license or equivalent state credential and agency privileges set practice authority. ACLS , PALS and PHTLS may appear in employer requirements. Work may include 12-lead ECG interpretation and ALS care under medical control , recorded in a patient care report .

paragraphs: Paramedics may perform more advanced prehospital care within their authorized scope; EMT training and skill scope are usually narrower, depending on local rules.
Prehospital emergency personnel work at the scene and during transport; emergency nurses carry out different duties within the hospital nursing system.
Ambulance drivers or attendants mainly drive and lift, and do not automatically hold Paramedic clinical authority.

Advanced prehospital emergency personnel (Paramedics) perform authorized advanced emergency care at the prehospital scene and hand over after transport; EMT training and scope of care differ, subject to local rules.
People who prefer high-pressure scene assessment, teamwork, and patient transport, and who will strictly follow licensure and medical direction, are a better fit for the Paramedic direction.
May 2025 OEWS covers U.S. wage and salary workers. The self-employed are outside the survey scope. May 2025 national medians: Paramedics (29-2043): $60,600/year.
